name: io.github.fluxer-mcp/fluxer-mcp
title: Fluxer MCP
description: Native Model Context Protocol server for Fluxer Cloud & self-hosted communities: 173 typed tools, blueprints, security audits, backups, and moderation.

environmentVariables.name: FLUXER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Fluxer bot token (with or without 'Bot ' prefix).

environmentVariables.name: FLUXER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Fluxer API base URL (defaults to https://api.fluxer.app; set for self-hosted instances).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_GUILDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated guild IDs the bot is allowed to operate on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Mutation policy: 'allow' or 'preview' (blocks all writes with a preview).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to allow confirmation-gated destructive operations (default: 'true').
